title: Maison Alyzée
notes: A text-layer PDF menu: pdf.js reads it straight out of the file, so it travels in the ordinary `content` field and either provider can serve it. The dish list is a spot-check, not the whole menu (the PDF runs to ~40 dishes across viennoiserie, breakfast, lunch and salads). "Quiche Veggie" is listed alongside the "Veggie" salad on purpose: the two share a token, so without an expectation of its own the quiche gets claimed by the salad's containment match whenever a model misses the salad, and a missed dish is scored as a wrong verdict instead.
